scope: Six compatibility-preserving correctness patches; existing uncommitted changes retained.

fixes.change: Shared safe vehicle physics guard for observations and manifests; unknown p4/p5 physics excluded; manifest limitations reach replay comparison.
fixes.regression: Disabled, inactive and unknown vehicles make zero physics getter calls; safe physics fields retained; comparison is unverified when information is missing.

fixes.change: Submitting thread deep-copies arrays and nested arguments; complete batch signatures, numeric data and worker availability checked before publication.
fixes.regression: Mutation after submission does not change worker input; invalid trajectories or signatures publish no batch requests.

fixes.change: Runtime preflight raises RequestRejected; service and clients preserve existing episode and lifecycle on explicit rejection.
fixes.regression: Raw IPC, Gym and vector rejected resets preserve episode/frame/availability; subsequent steps succeed; partial initialization failures still clean up and fault.

fixes.change: Gym trajectories rechecked for finite values after float32 conversion.
fixes.regression: Overflow and negative speed rejected locally; vector batch publishes no requests on overflow.

fixes.change: Pool and vector reject self/shared-client replacements before mutation; successful vector replacement requires reset even for an already-ready environment.
fixes.regression: Rejected replacements preserve original worker and observation; original worker remains usable; legitimate replacement, explicit reset and close pass.

fixes.change: Fleet management loads identity/log information separately from startup validation; restart validates before stopping.
fixes.regression: Missing worker config/interpreter/CARLA installation does not prevent status/stop; invalid starts/restarts rejected; PID reuse and ownership protections retained.
